ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.2
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Optional diagnostics companion for RimMT. v0.2 adds live current-Wait census, sampled WorkGiver and Pather child attribution, ReachProfile Region.Allows capture timing, pause/resume gap markers, catastrophic world-component timing, tail/Pawn/Job/GenClosest/Reachability/Map/World/Storyteller timing, Harmony census and reflective RimMT production summaries. Measurement-only: disable this mod for normal gameplay when diagnostics are not needed.
